generation_strategy: IMAGEN INDIVIDUAL 1024×1024. Un solo pickup centrado en canvas transparente. Tight bbox crop → resize 64×64.

frames.prompt: A single cartoon game collectible pickup item centered on a fully transparent background. The item is a floating RARE AMMO CRATE — a small chunky cartoon ammunition box/crate overflowing with 10 cartoon bullet cartridges. The crate itself is a small bold dark wooden/metal box with a bright golden clasp and bold charcoal outlines. Multiple fat brass bullet casings with glowing green lime tips (#44DD00) burst upward from the open top of the crate in an explosive fan. A bright glowing green aura radiates from the crate. A golden sparkle ring around the whole thing signals rarity. Tiny star sparkles float around it. Very clearly reads as RARE AMMUNITION JACKPOT. Cartoon chunky proportions, cel-shaded. Transparent background, nothing else.
